caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure with a stylized, worn appearance resembling weathered wood, as indicated by visible cracks and peeling paint. The figure has a rounded face with pinkish cheeks, dark eyes, and reddish lips, framed by dark brown, coiled hair on either side of the head. The bust wears a garment painted in muted greens and blues with hints of red along the edges, which also shows signs of wear and chipping. Below the bust, there are mechanical or architectural elements in brown and gray tones, including rounded sections and a central cylinder, giving the impression of mounted supports or wheels. The entire bust rests on a textured, rectangular base in grayish tones. The background is plain and off-white, with subtle smudges and marks around the image.
title: Figurehead from the "Lady Clinton"
